To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Australian child psychiatrists are not adequately monitoring for the physical health effects of antipsychotic medication in children and adolescents.

(1) the majority of child psychiatrists are not monitoring physical health or adverse effects in children and adolescents prescribed antipsychotics; and (2) there was a lack of knowledge regarding monitoring practices, the monitoring tools used and the monitoring frequency.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the monitoring of physical health and adverse effects of antipsychotic medications in children and adolescents.
the development and evaluation of an antipsychotic monitoring tool for use by clinicians in a tertiary paediatric hospital in South Australia.
the physical health and adverse effect monitoring of children and adolescents prescribed antipsychotic medication.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the evidence for antipsychotic treatment for children and adolescents is weak and inconclusive.
the evidence base for the use of antipsychotic medication in children and adolescents is very limited and that the use of antipyschotic medication in children is not supported.
the evidence is inconclusive and further research is necessary.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a package of tools to assist in monitoring of the physical health and adverse effects in children and adolescents prescribed antipsychotic medication.

CYWHS, in collaboration with CAMHS and the Royal Adelaide Hospital, has developed a package that includes a comprehensive monitoring tool, a monitoring checklist for use at each clinic visit, a patient information brochure and a letter to be sent to the general practitioner (GP) at the time of discharge.

the CYWHS Antipsychotic Monitoring Package is a new program that has recently been introduced to assist in monitoring physical health and adverse effects in children and adolescents prescribed antipsychotics.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the CYWHS Antipsychotic Monitoring Package is an example of a program that can be developed to facilitate physical health monitoring in children and adolescents prescribed antipsychotic medication.
the monitoring of physical effects of antipsychotic medications should be a routine part of clinical practice.
the CYWHS Antipsychotic Monitoring Package has been developed to facilitate the monitoring of physical health and adverse effects in children and adolescents who have been prescribed antipsychotics.
